title: Coherent Heterogeneous SoC — shared visual language study
alt: A planar SoC study with stacked CPU and NPU client groups, coherent fabric, memory and host paths. Unedited first pass with a remaining shared ownership error.
strengths: The whole figure remains front-facing and two-dimensional, with no package base, metallic texture or visible side faces.
Compared with v1, the color families are quieter and more consistent: parallel compute clients share blue, caches share warm pale fills, and host/context boundaries are restrained.
The left-to-right memory path and lower host ingress are largely straight. PCIe Endpoint now points toward Coherent Fabric, correcting the reversed direction seen in v1.
The title is integrated into the system boundary rather than occupying a large separate banner; names and peer groups are readable.
limitations: Coherent Fabric is outside the Shared Resources boundary. Source ownership places both Coherent Fabric and Shared LLC inside Shared Resources, so this image is not an accepted exact architecture diagram.

The compiled annotated_context view deliberately lists only the external DRAM and host links; the image still includes additional internal request paths from the retained source context despite explicit closed-scope instructions. Source-history leakage remains an observed limitation.
Ownership containers have broad tinted fills and visible tonal variation, although the shared graphic contract requests unfilled quiet ownership boundaries and solid flat fills.
Text, arrows and the outer boundary remain heavier than the requested restrained treatment. More whitespace is used inside the vertical fabric strip than needed.

This single fresh generation demonstrates observed changes, not stable success, a quality score, or correctness certification. It is comparison evidence and should not be presented as a validated final showcase.

provenance.workflow: Same saved source input → updated silicon_compile → exact compiled prompt → one fresh built-in Image Gen call; no reference image, augmentation or bitmap repair
provenance.actual_image_review: Visually inspected. Palette, planar layout and host direction improved relative to v1, but Shared Resources ownership and selected-view scope are not correct. Not accepted as an accurate final engineering figure.
